materiality.rationale: PluginEval uses deterministic validation, real API execution, adversarial negatives, and fine-grained error attribution across five model families; it matters because function-calling quality can be diagnosed by failure mode rather than reduced to a single success rate, within the benchmark's reported scope.

profile_annotations.why_this_issue: This is relevant to the issue because dependable tool use requires knowing whether a model selected the wrong function, formed a bad call, or failed execution; PluginEval makes that diagnostic framing explicit.
